subject.title: [V3.5] Cron de materialización de rating Rainforest a products.attributes

question: Should the Rainforest materialization now target the current `provider_records` plus `attributes.ratings.rainforest_es`/root `rating` contract, or preserve the issue's older `attributes.providersRatings.amazon` target?
rationale: Current dev changed both the provider-data source and the product rating schema after the issue was written, so automation should not choose the permanent data contract while the issue is assigned to a human owner.

options.title: Use current rating contract
options.body: Implement a small data-crons sync from provider-records/Rainforest payloads into `attributes.ratings.rainforest_es` and recompute root `rating`, preserving existing provider metadata.

options.title: Keep original target
options.body: Materialize only `attributes.providersRatings.amazon`, which matches the issue text but may create drift from the newer `attributes.ratings` convention.

options.title: Fold into broader provider backfill
options.body: Defer this issue until the provider-records backfill/state design owns Rainforest, Keepa, and future rating sources together.

recommendation.title: Use current rating contract
recommendation.body: Implement a small data-crons sync from provider-records/Rainforest payloads into `attributes.ratings.rainforest_es` and recompute root `rating`, preserving existing provider metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the live assignment and authored both the Rainforest-rating attempt and the later rating infrastructure work.
